about: GameTest classes whose method set differs between two coverage maps of one commit by more than timer noise (more than 5 methods and under 95% agreement, tools/gate/covmap.py NOISE_*), because the path they take depends on timing: what runs while they wait, a stress run's interleaving. The determinism check (gate.py covmap-compare, the weekly map's two replicas) ignores these and only these; the published map is the union of the replicas, so their sets are the larger of the two. Add a row only with the measured difference; remove one when a refresh shows the class within the noise. docs/GATE_B.md, 'The coverage map'.
